newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Boral to maintain half-year dividend.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Boral to maintain half-year dividend.

text.p: Building materials and energy group Boral Ltd said on Monday it would maintain a 7.5 cents per share dividend payment for the six months ended December 31, 1996, the same amount paid in the second half of 1995/96.

"...current levels of trading enable the directors to anticipate that the company will be able to maintain the 7.5 cents rate for the 1997 interim dividend," chairman Peter Cottrell told shareholders at the annual meeting.
Boral cut its 1995/96 second half to 7.5 cents a share, from 10.5 cents a share, due to the 30 percent fall in net profit to A$205.69 million in the year to June 30, 1996.
Boral's total dividend for 1995/96 fell to 18 cents a share from 21 cents a year earlier.
Cottrell also told the annual meeting that operating profit for the first four months of the current year was in line with budget but about 20 percent below year ago levels.
At 1.55 p.m. (0255 GMT), Boral shares were two cents lower at A$3.17
